text:
Eli: Quick sync 1: I'm changing examples to the compact envelope shape across the function-calling docs. Will add migration notes.
Fern: Nice. Could you include a tiny TS + Python parse-fallback snippet and a CLI jq example? Our infra customers love CLI.
docs-bot: PR opened by Eli: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3001 (draft)
Eli: Added `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_py.md` and `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_ts.md`. Also added `/examples/legacy/full-envelope.md` and `/examples/migration-checklist.md`.
Rakesh: Quick QA: found a stray reference in `best_practices.md` to the old shape. I'll paste grep hits in the PR.
Eli: Thanks 1: updated links to point at `/examples/legacy/*` and added redirects.
Fern: For the TS snippet, avoid `any` — use `unknown` then runtime-assert. Also include an example for when a tool returns `null` and we call the fallback parser.
Eli: Added a "null-tool-output" snippet and a unit test vector. Also a small `jq` one-liner under `/examples/cli_extract.md`: `jq -r '.compact.output | .items[]?.text' example.json`
TestRunner: CI: docs lint passed for PR #3001.
Rakesh: Minor nit: migration checklist should link to the SDK repo and to the sample tests. Can you add those?
Eli: Done. Added a short "team test checklist" (prompt + test vector + parse assertion) with pytest and simple TS asserts.
Fern: LGTM. Thanks for keeping the legacy example and adding the migration plan.
Eli: Merging in ~15 minutes unless any objections.
